dependencies: Python 3 standard library locally; server Python 3.6+ and systemctl.
Existing official Aliyun CLI 3.5.1 and externally configured profile. No credential files are included.
Existing Node executable, PM2 daemon/socket and pm2-axon / pm2-axon-rpc modules; no installation or daemon start is performed by this backup.
restorationNotes: The fixed instance, region, profile and filesystem locations are non-secret source bindings. Review them and obtain a new execution authorization before operational use.
A new separately reviewed intent is required. Actual intent, submit-attempt and invocation receipt files are not included and must not be reconstructed from this backup as live authorization.
The script retains projected stdout/stderr on nonzero command exit; template timer evidence remains distinct from live instance status.
read-schedules.sh embeds exactly audit.py, whose RPC string is exactly rpc-readonly.js. Preserve their source relationship.
The extracted RPC file lacks the outer probe daemon/PID/socket gate when run on its own.
Fixed timer names, eight PM2 names, limited proc inspection and nonmerged template files are a bounded audit, not a comprehensive scheduler inventory.
Future output requires its own safety review. Path projections are not a general credential or URL sanitizer.
excluded: Actual timer/service/cron/PM2 outputs, raw or decoded remote API results, submission intents, invocation receipts, private comparison reports, credentials, environment files and full argv.
verificationScope: Static source hash and embedding checks, plus exact remote byte verification. No source execution, tests, server calls, CI or deployment by this backup.
